Source [S1] also mentions using 'histogram-based sorting' and storing 'interesting' (non-zero) voxels. Since the sorting is the primary preprocessing step described for efficiency in these object-order methods, and histogram sort is $O(N)$, the evidence supports the claim that the complexity is $O(N)$ with histogram-based sorting for non-zero voxels.
